meta.title: NAOMI: Team 26, FIIT STU
meta.description: Team 26 at FIIT STU, Team Project course 2026/2027. We continue the development of a system that transfers human movement from video to the humanoid robot NAO.

hero.lead: NAOMI (NAO Motion Imitation) is the project of Team 26 in the Team Project course, academic year 2026/2027, at the Faculty of Informatics and Information Technologies STU in Bratislava. It is a system that captures human movement from video and transfers it to the humanoid robot NAO. We are the team continuing its development.
hero.imageAlt: Line drawing of a person and a robot with matching joints.

progress.label: Progress
progress.intro: We combine Scrum and Kanban. Work is planned in sprints that end with a review and a retrospective, while everyday tasks move across a shared Kanban board. Each sprint is summarised in a report below.
